summary: The compact steep-gabled silhouette, muted palette, pale roof trim, and paired dark vents make the cabin recognizable, but the exterior treatment and unverified entrance placement prevent approval.

orientation.summary: The located SV1 camera northwest of the cabin looks SE toward the -u/NNW gable; that visible gable clearly has the centered attic vent and low wall vent but no door, matching the rendered -u face. The only modeled door is on the opposite +u/SSE gable, which SV1 cannot show. Thus the model avoids duplicate portals and does not contradict the view, but no supplied source establishes that hidden +u door as the principal entry.

issues.problem: Principal-entry placement remains unresolved: the sole +u/SSE door is hidden from the only geolocated street view.
issues.fix: Provide face-resolved evidence of the +u gable or another view locating the real entrance; otherwise mark or revise the entrance only when supported.

issues.problem: The model reads as red brick on several walls, while SV1 shows reddish-brown timber/shingle siding, weakening the cabin’s characteristic appearance.
issues.fix: Replace the brick pattern with restrained reddish-brown wood or shingle siding while retaining the dark vents and pale trim.
